svg.title: The estuary observatory
svg.desc: An original mechanical waterfront drawing. Water height lifts a float and linked counterweight. Observed wind turns the vane and turbine. Predicted tidal change turns the water wheels. Exact readings and explanations are below the drawing.

g.text: AN IMAGINED MACHINE · MEASUREMENTS FROM A REAL PLACE
a drawing listening to the water.
DATUM IS A REFERENCE, NOT THE SEABED.
